article.title: 香港美酒展閉幕，業界買家與公眾試飲分設入口
article.title_en: Hong Kong wine fair closes after separate trade and public experiences
article.summary: 香港貿發局稱，展會吸引來自66個國家及地區的逾8,200名業界買家。
article.summary_en: The HKTDC reports more than 8,200 trade buyers from 66 countries and regions.
highlights: 最後一日設公眾專區，安排試飲及活動。
highlights_en: The final day offered a public zone with tastings and activities.
article.why: 酒類品牌可把分銷商洽談與消費者體驗分開設計，為兩種對象準備不同素材。
article.why_en: Wine brands can plan separate distributor meetings and consumer experiences, with different materials for each audience.
article.next_step: 分開整理買家跟進名單及試飲反饋，逐項確認有興趣的產品及渠道。
article.next_step_en: Separate buyer follow-ups from tasting feedback and record which products and channels drew interest.
article.detail: 貿發局在閉幕後公布買家人數，另列公眾日到場情況。兩組人數對應不同參與目的，品牌可按場景設計工作流程。買家會面可記錄分銷地區、供貨條件及樣品要求，公眾活動則可整理試飲偏好與常見查詢。下一步應以後續洽談或訂單衡量成果，保留原本的參與人數作背景。
article.detail_en: The organiser reported trade buyers separately from public attendance. Those groups have different purposes. Capture distribution markets, supply terms and sample requests in trade meetings, and log preferences and common questions during tastings. Use follow-up or orders to measure outcomes, with attendance as context.
